# Paired t-test sample size calculation
# Given parameters:
# - Mean weight reduction (effect size): 3 kg
# - Baseline SD: 5 kg
# - Follow-up SD: 5.5 kg
# - Within-person correlation: 0.5
# - Alpha (one-sided): 0.05
# - Target power: 0.80

# Step 1: Calculate the standard deviation of paired differences
sigma_baseline <- 5
sigma_followup <- 5.5
rho <- 0.5

# SD of paired differences: sqrt(sigma_baseline^2 + sigma_followup^2 - 2*rho*sigma_baseline*sigma_followup)
sd_diff <- sqrt(sigma_baseline^2 + sigma_followup^2 - 2*rho*sigma_baseline*sigma_followup)
cat("SD of paired differences:", sd_diff, "\n")

# Step 2: Set up test parameters
mean_reduction <- 3
alpha_one_sided <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.80

# For a one-sided test at alpha 0.05, we use the one-sided critical value
# This corresponds to a two-sided critical value of z_{alpha/2} where alpha/2 = 0.025
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha_one_sided)  # One-sided critical value
z_beta <- qnorm(target_power)          # Power-side critical value

cat("z_alpha (one-sided, alpha=0.05):", z_alpha, "\n")
cat("z_beta (power side, 80%):", z_beta, "\n")

# Step 3: Calculate required sample size using the standard formula
# n = (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * sd_diff^2 / mean_reduction^2
n_continuous <- (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * sd_diff^2 / mean_reduction^2
cat("Continuous sample size:", n_continuous, "\n")

# Step 4: Round up to nearest integer
n_required <- ceiling(n_continuous)
cat("Required sample size (rounded up):", n_required, "\n")

# Step 5: Verify achieved power at the required sample size
# Using the non-centrality parameter: ncp = mean_reduction / (sd_diff / sqrt(n))
ncp_required <- mean_reduction / (sd_diff / sqrt(n_required))
df <- n_required - 1
power_at_required <- 1 - pt(z_alpha, df = df, ncp = ncp_required)
cat("Achieved power at n =", n_required, ":", power_at_required, "\n")

# Step 6: Check power at n-1 to confirm n is the minimum integer
if (n_required > 1) {
  ncp_prev <- mean_reduction / (sd_diff / sqrt(n_required - 1))
  df_prev <- n_required - 2
  power_at_prev <- 1 - pt(z_alpha, df = df_prev, ncp = ncp_prev)
  cat("Achieved power at n =", n_required - 1, ":", power_at_prev, "\n")
}

# Store results for output
results_list <- list(
  sample_size = n_required,
  achieved_power = power_at_required,
  continuous_solution = n_continuous,
  sd_difference = sd_diff,
  z_alpha = z_alpha,
  z_beta = z_beta,
  power_at_prev = if (n_required > 1) power_at_prev else NA
)

# Prepare JSON output
cat("\nFinal Results:\n")
cat("Minimum sample size (integer):", n_required, "participants\n")
cat("Achieved power at n =", n_required, ":", round(power_at_required, 4), "\n")
cat("Power at n =", n_required - 1, ":", round(power_at_prev, 4), "\n")
cat("Continuous solution: n =", round(n_continuous, 2), "\n")

      list(metric = "achieved_power", value = round(power_at_required, 6), unit = "proportion"),

  digits = 15
)
